evidence: list_events: Failed to pull image registry.example.com/shop/payments:v1.4.3-rc: not found, then ImagePullBackOff

input.root_cause_hypothesis: The deployment references a tag that was never pushed (v1.4.3-rc); most likely a typo for v1.4.3 or a pipeline that tagged the image differently. A restart cannot help; the image reference has to change.
proposed_actions: Fix the image tag in the payments Deployment (kubectl set image deployment/payments payments=registry.example.com/shop/payments:v1.4.3 -n default) after confirming the tag exists in the registry
